items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The band was Eldridge, Tommy Turk, Parker, Flip Phillips, Prez. ... [INTERVIEWER] No, it was Eldridge, Tommy Turk, Parker, Phillips, Hank Jones, Ray Brown and Buddy Rich.

ctx.x: Oh, that was recorded? See, I didn't know that a lot of this was recorded. A lot of those things were recorded without our knowledge.
The band was Eldridge, Tommy Turk, Parker, Flip Phillips, Prez.
Yeah, Tommy was on that. Was Charlie Shavers on that?
